evidence: Ex situ normal-incidence transmittance measurements were carried out with a Carl Zeiss Jena spectrophotometer Specord M40 in the 350±840 nm wavelength range. The determination of the optical parameters of the grown films was based on a modified Valeev envelope method. The refractive indices of the substrates were calculated from the measured spectra of the bare substrates. In the experiments, additional diaphragms and an integrating sphere were used to cope with the instrumental error. The interferometric values of n and Dd, which are coinciding with the corresponding spectrophotometric values, are also constant within the experimental error. The ratio of reflectance increments D R rD R was observed.
